message.reasoning_content:
We need to extract crimes from facts. Facts: Husband repeatedly beats wife, on June 26 2016 he beat and insulted, later wife fell into river and drowned. Autopsy shows injuries consistent with neck strangulation and blunt force, causing light injury (second-degree). So he caused death. Crimes: intentional homicide? Actually he caused death by assault leading to drowning. Could be "故意伤害致人死亡" (intentional injury resulting in death) which is a crime under Chinese law: "故意伤害罪" causing death, which is punishable as "故意伤害致人死亡". Also "虐待家庭成员罪" (domestic violence). The text says: "故意伤害他人，致人轻伤，并虐待家庭成员，情节恶劣，致使被害人死亡". So crimes: "故意伤害致人死亡" and "虐待家庭成员罪". Possibly also "故意杀人罪"? But they said intentional injury, not intent to kill. So we list two crimes separated by semicolon.

Thus answer: [罪名]故意伤害致人死亡;虐待家庭成员<eoa>
